HenryLok0/IT114115-FYP-EaseParkHK.body:
# EaseParkHK (EasePark Hong Kong)

Collection of Hong Kong car park open data, quality analysis and short-term vacancy prediction. Results are publicly displayed using **GitHub Pages**. No backend, no login, no Gemini.

## Research Question

Using Transport Department open data, can we predict private car parking vacancies for the next 30 minutes? How much lower is the error compared to the 'assume same as now' (persistence baseline)?

The website is only a demonstration layer of the methodology. Contributions are in the dataset, missing value rules, baseline and MAE/RMSE, not account systems.

## Refactored Features

| Old Flask web app | Current Pages |
| --- | --- |
| On-the-fly `requests` / `pandas.read_excel` | GitHub Actions writes JSON every 15 minutes, webpage reads files |
| Login, email reset, Flask-Login, session | Abandoned |
| Favorites using server session | `localStorage` (limited to same browser only) |
| Gemini chatbox | Abandoned (API key cannot be placed in frontend) |
| follow / Post / Product / Brand tutorial code | Deleted |
| "True real-time backend" | "Latest snapshot" + if CORS allows, browser calls government API again |

## Local Preview of Static Site

```sh
git clone https://github.com/yourusername/IT114115-FYP-EaseParkHK.git
cd IT114115-FYP-EaseParkHK
python scripts/run_pipeline.py
python -m http.server 8080 --directory docs
```

Open `http://localhost:8080` in your browser. The collector does not need `.env` and has no API key.

Testing:

```sh
python tests/test_collect_vacancy.py
python tests/test_forecast_and_feeds.py
```

`--skip-feeds` can skip meter Excel/news/camera feeds (faster):

```sh
python scripts/run_pipeline.py --skip-feeds
```

## GitHub Pages

1. Push to default branch.
2. **Settings → Pages**: Source = Deploy from a branch, branch = `main`, folder = `/docs`.

Hjdd14/Mconnect-Music_connect.body:
# Mconnect

This project is developed with AI-assisted programming.

Mconnect is a Flutter Android music aggregation app that uses a unified interface to aggregate search, playback, lyrics, playlists, favorites, downloads, and local music capabilities from NetEase Cloud Music, QQ Music, and KuGou Music.

> Note: Third-party music platform APIs may change, and login status, VIP playback, and high-quality downloads are ultimately determined by the platform's backend. This project does not save any real account credentials to the repository; runtime sessions are only stored locally on user devices.

## Features Overview

- Multi-platform Search: Supports searching for songs or playlists across NetEase Cloud, QQ Music, and KuGou.
- Player: Supports playback queue, previous/next track, mini player, fullscreen player, progress memory, and audio quality selection.
- Lyrics: Supports LRC/QRC/KRC timed lyrics; when platforms provide character-by-character or translated lyrics, they are synced as much as possible.
- Music Library: Contains liked songs, listening history, platform playlists, imported playlists, local music, and download management.
- Playlists: Supports viewing platform playlists, importing share links, creating and managing local "My Playlists".
- Local Music: Supports selecting directories to scan local songs and matching corresponding lyrics timed files.
- Downloads: Supports download queue, custom download directory, opening download folder, and deleting local files when removing download records.
- Accounts: Independent login and logout for each platform; login sessions are saved locally via `flutter_secure_storage`.
- Custom Theme Colors: Supports switching between multiple preset theme colors; settings take effect immediately and persist.
- Desktop Floating Lyrics: Supports enabling Android floating window lyrics with customizable lyrics color, highlight color, font size, and stroke width; supports dragging and scaling.
- Listening Statistics: Adds local listening statistics, recording total play count, cumulative listening time, and favorite songs ranking.
- Sleep Timer: Supports setting timer duration; playback automatically pauses when countdown ends.
- Fade In/Out: Optional toggle for smooth volume transition when switching tracks.
- Equalizer: Supports Android native equalizer with preset switching and manual five-band adjustment.
- Offline Cache Center: Supports setting cache size limit, Wi-Fi-only caching, auto-cleanup, and other policies.
- Smart Playlists: Supports auto-generating local playlists based on rules like platform, keywords, minimum play count, recently played, liked only, cached only, etc.
- Diagnostics: Includes slow operation logs and UI stutter monitoring; log files have size limits to prevent unbounded growth.

Currently, daily recommendations only enable verified stable NetEase Cloud entries; QQ Music and KuGou daily recommendation API stability is not guaranteed as a stable feature.

## Technology Stack

| Module | Technology |
| --- | --- |
| Framework | Flutter 3.38.4 / Dart 3.10.3 |
| Platform | Android |
| State Management | Riverpod |
| Routing | GoRouter |
| Networking | Dio |
| Audio Playback | just_audio / audio_service |
| Database | drift + SQLite |
| Local Persistence | Hive / flutter_secure_storage |

# AIBasedTRPG

AIBasedTRPG is an AI TRPG assistant tool based on a Flask backend and static HTML/CSS/JavaScript frontend. The current architecture preserves the original pages, interface paths, JSON data formats, and global frontend functions, and gradually splits them into modules that are easier to test and maintain.

## Environment Setup

```powershell
python -m venv .venv
.\.venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1
pip install -r requirements.txt
```

This project also requires `node` to be available on the local machine for building browser-executable scripts from TypeScript source code.

## Startup

After cloning the source code from GitHub, first install dependencies and build the frontend:

```powershell
npm install
npm run build:frontend
```

Then start the backend service:

```powershell
python server.py
```

The service reads the port configuration from `data/config/network.json` by default, and uses `8086` when unconfigured. You can also pass the port via command line:

```powershell
python server.py 8090
```

If the target port is already in use, the service will attempt to find a nearby available port and output the listening address in the logs, for example `listening on http://127.0.0.1:8086`, local network address, and virtual network card addresses such as ZeroTier/Tailscale.

## First Deployment Guide

The program has a built-in first-time deployment guide page for completing initialization in a self-hosted environment, without needing to manually edit configuration files or use console commands to create accounts.

**Trigger Condition**: When the system **does not yet have any OWNER account**, opening the homepage in a browser will automatically pop up a full-screen step-by-step guide. Once an OWNER exists, the guide no longer appears, and related write endpoints will also return `403` (preventing already-deployed instances from being reinitialized by others).

The guide appears only once: after clicking "Skip all guides" at the bottom, the server will record `setup_dismissed: true` in `data/config/site.json`, and the browser will also remember this choice; subsequent refreshes will not display it. If you want to show the guide again, simply delete the `setup_dismissed` field in `site.json` (at which point the system must still have no OWNER).

The guide consists of 5 steps:

1. **Configure AI API**: Choose a platform (DeepSeek / OpenAI / Alibaba Cloud Bailian / SiliconFlow / OpenRouter / LM Studio / Custom), fill in the API address compatible with OpenAI protocol, API Key, and model ID. hoons1994/ShutterSoundZero.body: # Shutter Sound Zero > Camera shutter sound settings tool for Samsung Galaxy phones --- ## 📖 Introduction Shutter Sound Zero is an open-source Android app that manages camera shutter sound behavior using Samsung Galaxy's stock system (CSC) settings. It does not continuously monitor the screen or camera execution using accessibility services. After initially linking the `WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS` permission via local wireless ADB once, you can change the actual CSC values by enabling wireless debugging only when needed. The current app version is **v1.5.10**. magisk317/xinyi-relay.body:
# Xinyi Relay

Xinyi Relay is a message forwarding and automatic verification code filling tool for Xposed/LSPosed, supporting unified processing from SMS, app notifications, incoming calls, and other sources.

The project currently consists of three main components:

- Mobile (Android): Responsible for local event collection, verification code parsing, automatic input, and Xposed Hook
- Backend: Responsible for multi-device binding, configuration snapshots, record reporting, and cloud Web console
- Desktop: Cross-platform desktop management tool with built-in local SQLite database, supporting independent offline operation and cloud synchronization

The old embedded WebUI has been removed from the Android main execution chain. The current official architecture is `Android Agent + Backend / Desktop` working in coordination.

[English Version](https://github.com/magisk317/xinyi-relay/blob/HEAD/README-EN.md)

# Application Screenshots

# Communication and Feedback
- [Telegram Group](https://t.me/+NR2QaQ4dlEgxYmNl)

## Mobile

The mobile is a runtime-adaptive Android Agent: when a valid Xposed/LSPosed runtime is detected, it enters Enhanced mode; when there is no Xposed, it uses the system API to enter Standard mode. Both modes use the same APK, application identity, database, and configuration.

### Installation and Usage
1. Install Xinyi Relay:
   - GitLab Release: Provides APK download
   - Google Play: Provides store distribution
2. Standard mode grants permissions for SMS, MMS, call, or notification listening as needed based on what the current release package actually declares; denying a permission will only disable the corresponding capability.
3. If you need Enhanced capabilities such as Hook interception, system-level SMS blocking, and Hook keep-alive, then select to Root the device and activate the module in LSPosed/Xposed; no need to flash another lite APK.
4. Configure forwarding channels, routing rules, interception policies, and verification code features within the app.

### Compatibility
- Minimum Android 8.0 (API 26).
- Suitable for relatively stock systems; third-party deeply customized ROMs may have compatibility differences.

### Main Capabilities
- SMS forwarding: Forward verification code SMS and regular SMS according to rules
- App notification forwarding: Bind forwarding channels at the app level
- Incoming call information forwarding: Extract and forward incoming call information
- Global/app-level forwarding filtering: Policy control through keywords, sources, priority, etc.
- Automatic verification code parsing, copying, and auto-filling
- Verification code rules: Built-in official read-only rules, remote cache refresh, and user-defined rule hierarchical merging
- Records and backup: Support exporting/importing configuration and history records

DUIThink is a free and open-source DirectUI interface library for Windows that includes a complete set of desktop software development components. Functional components include (thread pool, file operations, IOCP network model, file monitoring, registry monitoring, file drag-and-drop, command-line parsing, magnetic absorption algorithm, memory pool, resolution conversion, string operations, etc.). QQ Group: 885314879

- MFC cannot create elaborate UIs, many parts require custom drawing, and modifications are cumbersome

racheko-lab/blive-monitor.body:
# 📡 Bilibili/Douyin Live Broadcast Monitoring + Multi-channel Push

A lightweight live broadcast monitoring tool that supports Bilibili and Douyin platforms, automatically sending notifications through multiple channels (Bark / Server Sauce / Enterprise WeChat / PushPlus / Telegram) when going live / releasing new works.

## ✨ Features

- 🎬 **Multi-platform Support**: Monitor Bilibili and Douyin livestreams simultaneously
- 🔔 **Multi-channel Push**: Send notifications through Bark / Server Sauce / Enterprise WeChat / PushPlus / Telegram when going live / releasing new works
- 📊 **Live Duration Statistics**: Record live duration and last broadcast time
- 📝 **History Logs**: Keep the latest 200 status change records
- 🔄 **Merged Push**: Merge multiple notifications into one when multiple anchors go live simultaneously
- 📱 **Responsive Page**: Mobile-friendly monitoring page
- 🎵 **New Works Detection**: Support for detecting new Douyin works publishing (optional)

## 📋 Quick Start

### 1. Configure Monitored Rooms

Edit the `rooms.json` file to add anchors you want to monitor:

```json
[
  {
    "platform": "bilibili",
    "id": "1874913653",
    "name": "峰哥亡命天涯"
  },
  {
    "platform": "douyin",
    "id": "83134194400",
    "name": "27～"
  }
]
```

**Field Description:**

- `platform`: Platform, `bilibili` or `douyin`
- `id`: Room ID
  - Bilibili: Room number (the number in the URL, such as `https://live.bilibili.com/1874913653`)
  - Douyin: Room web_rid (the string in the URL, such as `https://live.douyin.com/83134194400`)
- `name`: Anchor name (used for display and push notifications)

### 2. Configure Push Channels (Optional)

Live / new works notifications support multiple channels, configured via the `BLIVE_CONFIG` environment variable (JSON):

```bash
# Bark (iPhone, recommended)
export BLIVE_CONFIG='{"push": {"type": "bark", "url": "https://api.day.app/你的KEY", "group": "blive"}}'

# or Enterprise WeChat group bot (free and unlimited, recommended)
export BLIVE_CONFIG='{"push": {"type": "wecom", "webhook": "https://qyapi.weixin.qq.com/cgi-bin/webhook/send?key=xxxx"}}'

# or...
```

Windows Wubi input method based on RIME engine, built with Rust + TSF.

> ⚠️ Note: This project is still in development. Do not use in production.

## Quick Start

```powershell
# Development build (build + register + start server)
.\rebuild.ps1

# Package MSI installer
.\msi-build.ps1

# Package MSIX app package
.\msix-bundle.ps1

# Package and test installation (no signature required)
.\msix-bundle.ps1 -InstallUnsigned
```

## Installation

### MSI Installation (Administrator privilege)

```powershell
msiexec /i target\wix\ximeyao-{version}-x86_64.msi
```

### MSIX Installation

```powershell
# Package and install directly (development testing, no signature required)
.\msix-bundle.ps1 -InstallUnsigned

# Package, sign, and install
.\msix-bundle.ps1 -Sign

# Generate unsigned MSIX (for store submission)
.\msix-bundle.ps1
```

After installation, press `Win+Space` to switch to Xime Yao input method.

## Development Build

### Prerequisites

- Rust toolchain (nightly, with `rust-toolchain.toml` included in the project)
- Visual Studio Build Tools (C++ support)
- CMake
- WiX Toolset v3.14 (for MSI packaging)
- Windows SDK (for MSIX packaging)

### Data Directory Structure

```

├── winxime-server.exe        # IPC server process

├── user-data/                # Scheme files (deployed to %APPDATA% on first launch)

# AI Intelligent Customer Service System (AIKF) > A multi-tenant AI intelligent customer service SaaS platform for general industries, using the fabric curtain industry as a sample scenario. > Built on large language models (DeepSeek V4 Pro + DeepSeek V4 Flash Vision) + business tools (**quantity sourced from the registry as single source of truth**, recalculation command see "Version Source of Truth" in "Tech Stack"), covering the complete chain from pre-sales consultation to post-sales service. ## ✨ Core Highlights - **Dual Agent Architecture** — C-end customer service "Xiaobu" + B-end work assistant "Mibao", driven by LangGraph state machine - **AI Tools** — product search, order management, logistics tracking, customer query, etc., automatic intent routing (quantity sourced from `registry.py` registry as single source of truth) - **Multi-tenant SaaS** — tenant isolation (JWT-derived tenant_id → MyBatis tenant interceptor → field desensitization) - **Complete Business Backend** — 12+ management modules including products, orders, CRM, human agents, data dashboard, etc. - **WeChat Mini Program** — Taro cross-platform framework, SSE streaming chat, native experience - **Alibaba Cloud Full-Stack Deployment** — SWAS lightweight application server (CI builds image + server pull) + RDS + Redis(Tair) + OSS, GitHub Actions CI/CD > ℹ️ **Knowledge Base Note**: The old RAG knowledge base (vector search document library) has been completely removed along with the LLM WIKI section (issue #3051). Knowledge Q&A adopts a "knowledge card" model: one-click application of industry templates + automatic derivation of products/configurations + AI extraction from conversations/documents pending confirmation, AI customer service directly reads published knowledge cards to answer questions, retrieval uses structured filtering + keywords (no vector library). Design see `docs/design/knowledge-wiki-design.md`. ## 🏗️ System Architecture ```mermaid graph TB subgraph Client A[WeChat Mini Program

41 tables)] C --> F[(Redis 7
session / cache)] D -->… ```

zhoujungis/zhoujungis.github.io.description: Personal blog - an open-source free blogging solution for young people, leveraging GitHub Pages and PythonAnywhere for free deployment of frontend, backend, and database
zhoujungis/zhoujungis.github.io.body:
# Zhou Jun's Blog

> A personal blog recording technology, travel, and life, featuring a natural-colored responsive interface and frontend-backend separation architecture.

🔗 **Visit Online:** [zhoujungis.github.io](https://zhoujungis.github.io)

---

## ✨ Features

- 📝 **Article Management** — Markdown writing + Vditor online editor, supports drafts/publishing/pinning/scheduled publishing
- 🏷️ **Categories & Tags** — Article categorization, tag cloud, category filtering
- 💬 **Comment System** — Supports replies, nested comments, honeypot anti-spam
- 🔍 **Full-text Search** — Backend Django search, search result highlighting
- 🖼️ **Photo Gallery** — Image display + lightbox preview
- 🔗 **Friendly Links** — Dedicated links page
- 🗺️ **Footprint Map** — ECharts China map, city markers visited, grouped statistics by region
- 🌓 **Light/Dark Theme** — Warm white natural color / deep green dark color, auto memory
- 📡 **RSS Subscription** — Atom Feed
- 📧 **Email Subscription** — Auto notify subscribers on new articles (supports 163/QQ/Gmail SMTP)
- 📊 **Admin Dashboard** — Dashboard, article management, comment moderation, subscriber management
- 🦊 **Live2D Character** — Cute character in bottom right corner
- 🎨 **Natural Responsive UI** — Pine green and terracotta color scheme, restrained animations, skeleton loading
- 📱 **PWA** — Service Worker offline caching, installable to desktop

---

## 🏗️ Architecture

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────┐
│          GitHub Pages (Frontend)          │
│      Vue 3 + Vite SPA               │
│          ↕ REST API                  │
│    PythonAnywhere (Backend)             │
│      Django + DRF + SQLite          │
└─────────────────────────────────────┘
```

| Layer | Tech Stack | Deployment |
|----|--------|----------|
| Frontend | Vue 3 + Vite + Vue Router + Pinia + Axios + SCSS + ECharts | GitHub Pages |
| Backend | Django 5.x + DRF + SimpleJWT + SQLite |…
